title: Neural Field Thermal Tomography: A Differentiable Physics Framework for Non-Destructive Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2603.11045v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Inverse problems for stiff parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs), such as the inverse heat conduction problem (IHCP), are severely ill-posed: the forward map rapidly damps high-frequency interior structure before it reaches the boundary. Soft-constrained physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), which embed the PDE as a residual penalty, decouple the diffusivity from the surface data in their standard two-network inverse formulation, and the evaluated variants fit boundary measurements while leaving the interior field essentially untouched. We propose Neural Field Thermal Tomography (NeFTY), a hard-constrained neural field framework for label-free three-dimensional inverse heat conduction. NeFTY represents the unknown diffusivity as a continuous coordinate-based neural network, and at every optimization step passes the candidate field through a differentiable implicit-Euler heat solver with harmonic-mean interface flu

translated_title: 神经场热断层扫描（NeFTY）：一种面向无损检测的可微物理框架
translated_abstract: 对于刚性抛物型偏微分方程（PDE）的逆问题，例如逆热传导问题（IHCP），其病态性非常严重：正向映射会在内部高频结构到达边界之前将其迅速衰减。软约束的物理信息神经网络（PINNs）将PDE作为残差惩罚项嵌入，在其标准的双网络逆问题建模中使扩散率与表面数据解耦；我们评估的这些变体虽然能够拟合边界测量值，但内部场却基本保持原样、未被触及。我们提出了神经场热断层扫描，这是一个用于无标签三维逆热传导问题的硬约束神经场框架。NeFTY将未知的扩散率表示为连续的基于坐标的神经网络，并在每个优化步骤中将候选场通过一个带调和平均界面通量的可微隐式欧拉热求解器……
tldr: 该论文提出NeFTY，一种硬约束神经场框架，将未知扩散率表示为基于坐标的神经网络并嵌入可微隐式欧拉热求解器中端到端优化，从而解决了传统PINN无法恢复内部结构的严重病态三维逆热传导（热断层扫描）问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes NeFTY, a hard-constrained neural field framework that represents the unknown diffusivity as a coordinate-based network passed through a differentiable implicit-Euler heat solver at every optimization step, enabling label-free 3D thermal tomography for the severely ill-posed inverse heat conduction problem where soft-constrained PINNs leave the interior field essentially untouched.
